items.title: Documents folder
items.detail: Copies of your passport, visa, admit letter and marksheets. Keep them in your hand bag.

items.title: Medicines and prescription
items.detail: Carry your regular medicines and your doctor's prescription.

items.title: Adapter and charger
items.detail: The plugs there may be different. Take a universal adapter.

items.title: First month's budget
items.detail: Keep money aside for rent, food and travel in the first month.
